claim_boundary: Exact finite combinatorial duality between the boundary of the order-four permutohedron and the barycentric subdivision of the tetrahedral boundary. This does not yet transport Marici constructor, observation, mate, or filler semantics.

dictionary.subdivision_shared_wall: two maximal flags differing at one rank
dictionary.permutohedron_facet: nonempty proper subset I, containing schedules whose first |I| entries form I
dictionary.permutohedron_bulk: cone from the full-set vertex over the subdivided tetrahedral boundary

reopening_condition: Assign every ground-set element and every subset stratum its source-derived A6/A7 interface and prove that the incidence duality preserves evaluation.
